Project Sponsor: Thoran of the Bantus Empire

Project Site: Beneath Darkmire Cliff, east of Novaris

Project Scope: Build an underground Refinery to hold living prisoners captured by Bantus forces. Once the Refinery is complete, it will be used to develop and build a Soul Forge capable of converting the living into Graveborn.

Construction Schedule: To be decided after further discussion with Pride, Sloth, and the Bantus Empire.

Expected Returns: To be calculated once the project details are finalized.

项目投资方：班题斯帝国，托安
项目选址：诺珐斯城东厄冥岩涯地下
项目建设内容：建造位于地下的炼化间，用于储存班题斯帝国从战场前线俘虏而来的生者。炼化间完工后，于内部研发并建造亡灵转化器，其用途为：将生者转化为亡灵。
项目建造进度安排：待与“傲慢”、“懒惰”、班题斯帝国详细讨论
经济效益估算：待讨论后进行估算

document:1:634:0.text:
Project Overview:
Recreate the main function of Bantus' lost Graveborn relic and use a controlled magical ritual to convert the living into Graveborn.

Technical Basis:
Gravecalling draws on <style="highlight">death energy</style>. Converting a living person into Graveborn requires a large and stable supply of it. The Soul Forge creates a temporary field that gathers death energy from the surrounding world, concentrates it, and channels it into the subject.
The lost Graveborn relic worked in much the same way. However, <style="highlight">it already held a large reserve of death energy</style>, so it could perform the conversion more easily.

Soul Forge Design:
Control Room: Used to activate the Soul Forge.
Altar: Where the living subject stands during the conversion.
Protective Barrier: Separates the control room from the altar. If the concentrated death energy reaches nearby Graveborn, it could kill them a second time and erase them completely.

Risk Warning:
<style="highlight">Once the conversion begins, it cannot be stopped.</style> In addition, the <style="highlight">altar is extremely fragile</style> and must be protected throughout the ritual. No effective way to reinforce it has yet been found.
document:1:634:0.source_cn:
项目概论：
复现班题斯遗失之亡灵圣器的核心功能，通过可控的魔法仪式，将生者转化为亡灵。
技术原理分析：
亡灵魔法源于<style="highlight">死亡之力</style>，将生者转化为亡灵之过程需要大量稳定的死亡之力。转化器之核心功能即通过特定魔力脉网，构建一个临时力场，短暂富集并借用世间散落的死亡之力，作用于生者。
其转化原理与亡灵圣器类似，但<style="highlight">亡灵圣器天然保存着强大的死亡之力</style>，使用其转化更为简单便捷。
转化器架构设计：
转化操作间——启动转化器之处。
祭坛——生者所站立之处，转化发生之处。
魔法防护屏障——隔绝操作间与祭坛，避免富集的死亡之力波及周围亡灵，致使亡灵经历二次死亡，彻底消散。
风险预警：
<style="highlight">转化一旦启动便无法停止</style>，且因其<style="highlight">祭坛异常脆弱</style>，仪式过程中务必严防破坏。暂无有效办法加固，有待研究。
